description: Quality gates fmt-check diff around 'use bitty_ipc_api::error::IpcError' plus unresolved crate::error path in bitty-ipc-auth test code (E0433 on all platforms, surfaced loudest on Windows). PeerCredentials::new/VerifiedPeer::attested were cfg(test)-gated to bitty-ipc-auth's own test binary only, so downstream crates (bitty-ipc-devtools, bitty-ipc) referencing them from their own tests failed to compile. Fix: correct the ErrorClass path to bitty_ipc_api::error::ErrorClass, add a test-support feature to bitty-ipc-auth gating these constructors, wire dev-dependencies with that feature in bitty-ipc-devtools and bitty-ipc, run cargo fmt --all. No public API removed or renamed; ServeContext::with_granted/with_granted_session/issue_automation_bearer and the bitty-ipc test-support feature stay intact for the bitty core pin at 6841646.
title: Fix main CI: rustfmt diff + Windows E0433 in bitty-ipc-auth

description:
Priority: P1 | Area: security | Labels: feat, P1 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: none | Task: CTX-0015

Add the pure provider-publication control contract module to crates/bitty-ipc-api, as required by the accepted draft placement in bitty-ai-docs architecture/authenticated-provider-publication.md (merged dbb2829): bounded provider-routing DTOs, the binary control record codec, named policy constants, and test vectors only. No TLS, authentication, OS work, provider I/O, registry population, secret resolution, or proof minting; no dependencies beyond std.

Scope:
- Fixed record header: magic ASCII BPPC, version u16=1, kind u16, sender u8 (1 Core, 2 helper), sequence u64, session_id bytes32.
- Records 1-13 (Establish, Established, Projection, Publish, Ack, Bind, Bound, Invalidate, Reserved/error, Lifetime, Admit, Admitted, Error) with the exact bodies/fields from the spec, closed enums, u32 big-endian lengths, no padding/trailing bytes, checked arithmetic.
- Named bounds constants single-sourced from the spec: CONTROL_FRAME_MAX_BYTES 256 KiB, CONTROL_INFLIGHT_MAX_BYTES 512 KiB, CONTROL_SMALL_RECORD_MAX_BYTES 4 KiB, CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP_MAX_BYTES 4 KiB, CONTROL_PAYLOAD_MAX_BYTES (frame minus 512), CONTROL_MODELS_MAX 64, CONTROL_CAPABILITIES_MAX 8, CONTROL_STRING_MAX_BYTES 128, CONTROL_JSON_DEPTH_MAX 8, RANDOM_ID_BYTES 32, and the other control-record bounds.
- Provider-routing DTOs and canonical byte encoding for the projection/publish payload (port the exact canonical rules from the reviewed bitty-ai exact-byte baseline; no divergence), with bounded strings/models/capabilities.
- Test vectors: round-trip encode/decode of every kind, unknown kind/version/sender/reason/error rejection, sequence/session validation helpers, truncation/oversize/trailing rejection, canonical-byte stability vectors, and bound limit/limit+1.
- Keep the crate zero-dependency and std-only.

Out of scope: TLS/bootstrap transport (owned by bitty-network CTX-0075 and bitty-ai AI-0333), receiver state machines, Core/helper integration, consumer pin upgrades (follow-up tasks after merge).

Deliverable: scoped branch/worktree, tests, local gates, PR; independent review.
title: Pure provider-publication control contract module in bitty-ipc-api
